end.summary:
Named earthworm and ant; identified that ants have six legs.
Discussed that earthworms do not have legs, but the idea that all creepy-crawly animals are insects remained.
Practised earthworm tunnels letting air and water into soil and soil animals changing dead leaves into rich soil.
Earthworm and soil-animal explanations were not completed independently; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming soil animals and used the six-leg clue to discuss insects. Pihu noticed that earthworms have no legs, but the mix-up that all creepy-crawly animals are insects was not corrected by the end. At home, sort picture cards into “insects” and “not insects,” then talk about how earthworm tunnels help air and water enter soil and how dead leaves become rich soil.
